notice: Single source enforced by scripts/release-readiness.mjs and the release workflow for exact 1.0.0 and 1.0.0-rc.N. Decisions carry recommended values but stay red until a human sets status to approved with decidedBy/decidedAt. Derived gates re-evaluate from committed evidence on every run; operator gates require an attestation file whose statements are all literally true. Governed 0.x release ceremonies remain unaffected by the 1.0 readiness check.
